easyPrerequisites:
Oreskos Sun Guide doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Seeker of Skybreak is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide using Seeker of Skybreak's ability by tapping it, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
